description: React component for rendering and managing the emoji picker results list with infinite scrolling, filtering, and category handling.

classes.name: EmojiPickerCurrentResults
classes.description: React functional component for displaying emoji picker results with infinite loading and category filtering.

methods.name: getItemKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for each row based on whether it is a category header or an emoji row.

methods.name: handleScroll
methods.description: Handles scroll events to update the active category based on scroll position.

methods.name: throttledScroll
methods.description: A throttled version of handleScroll to optimize scroll event handling.

methods.name: handleIsItemLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a given item index is loaded.

methods.name: handleLoadMoreItems
methods.description: Loads more custom emojis when needed, updating the page count.
